title: Program Development & Optimization
summary: This module provides advanced tools for building, optimizing, and refining DSPy programs. It includes sophisticated predictors for complex tasks, utilities for analyzing program behavior and generating instructions, and a suite of teleprompters for automated prompt engineering and model optimization.

nodes.label: Advanced Predictors & Flow Control
nodes.title: Predictors & Program Flow
nodes.description: Provides sophisticated DSPy predictors for complex tasks, enabling iterative refinement, tool-use, code execution, and aggregation strategies for robust program logic.

nodes.label: Program Analysis & Instruction Proposal
nodes.title: Program Analysis & Instruction
nodes.description: Offers tools for analyzing datasets, describing program functionality, and generating optimized instructions for language models to refine DSPy components and improve performance.

nodes.label: Teleprompters & Optimizers
nodes.title: DSPy Teleprompters & Optimizers
nodes.description: Contains various teleprompters and optimizers for automated prompt engineering, few-shot example selection, and model fine-tuning to enhance program performance and efficiency.

nodes.label: DSPy Program (User-defined)
nodes.title: User-defined DSPy Program
nodes.description: The core DSPy program or module that users define, which is then enhanced, optimized, and executed by components within this module to achieve specific goals.

nodes.label: Evaluation Metrics
nodes.title: DSPy Evaluation Metrics
nodes.description: Functions and modules used to assess the performance and quality of DSPy programs and their outputs against defined criteria and benchmarks.

nodes.label: Datasets & Examples
nodes.title: DSPy Datasets & Examples
nodes.description: Collections of input-output examples used for training, development, and evaluation of DSPy programs and their components, providing ground truth for optimization.

nodes.label: Language Models (LLMs)
nodes.title: Underlying Language Models
nodes.description: The large language models that DSPy programs interact with for text generation, reasoning, and other AI capabilities, serving as the core intelligence.

groups.label: Program Execution & Control
groups.title: Program Execution & Control
groups.description: Manages the execution flow of DSPy programs, including advanced prediction strategies and control mechanisms for complex, multi-step reasoning.

groups.label: Program Analysis & Instruction Generation
groups.title: Program Analysis & Instruction
groups.description: Provides tools for understanding program behavior, analyzing datasets, and generating effective instructions for LLMs to improve program clarity and performance.

groups.label: Optimization & Refinement
groups.title: Optimization & Refinement
groups.description: Contains a suite of teleprompters and optimizers for automated prompt engineering, few-shot learning, and model adaptation to enhance program performance and efficiency.

groups.label: External Interactions
groups.title: External System Interactions
groups.description: Represents the external DSPy components and data sources that this module interacts with to build, evaluate, and optimize programs, such as user-defined programs, datasets, and LLMs.
